entities.summary:
Palazzo Ariani, also known as Palazzo Ariani Minotto Cicogna, is a palace in Venice, located in the Dorsoduro district, almost opposite to the church of 
Angelo San Raffaele and not far from San Sebastiano. The nearby bridge Ponte del Soccorso connects it to the Palazzo Zenobio.
